classification: LIVE SAPI synthesis played on the real default output device

chunkOrderAndCancel.name: V18 speech chunks play strictly in seq order on the null sink
V19 V20 speak.cancel stops audible playback and nothing from that gen starts afterwards
V21 a late speak with an old gen after cancel never plays
V18 TTS chunks are ordered with strictly increasing seq from 0
V18 chunks split at sentence boundaries once at least 40 chars are speakable
V18 a delta stream split inside words yields the same ordered text as the whole answer
V18 an unclosed code fence at the end of the answer is dropped, not read
V06 V18 hard split keeps every chunk at or under the 400 char limit on word boundaries
V21 a self-transition is not a transition and is refused
V17 V18 playback confirmed by the worker moves the session to SPEAKING with truthful playing
V19 V20 barge-in: generation advances, speech is cancelled at the old gen, the voice turn's inference is stopped
V21 late model deltas and worker playback events from the cancelled generation never restart speech
V17 TTS playback works: real playback truth reads Speaking, and only then
V18 TTS chunks in order: the answer text is shown whole and not reordered by the view model
V20 pending chunks do not resume: nothing reads Speaking unless the playback flag is set
V21 late model callbacks do not restart playback: a finished session never reads Speaking
